newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK-VOLUMES SURGE,BANK SHRS FIRM.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK-VOLUMES SURGE,BANK SHRS FIRM.

text.p: Banking shares remained well-supported while other shars were untraded or unchanged on the Botswana Stock Exchange (BSE) last week, which saw volumes surge and the index inch up.
The BSE cautioned shareholders that talks were in progress that could affect the share price of Kgolo Ya Sechaba.
Botswana Insurance enjoyed active trade, closing five thebe up at 200 thebe. Realestate Development, Engen, Inco, Kgolo Ya Sechaba, Metsef and Sechaba were untraded.
Volumes surged to 213,600 shares changing hands from 40,955 shares previously, at a value of 443,455 pula from 209,379 pula.
The index closed 1.67 points up at 348.70 points.
